items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost goal-line/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass-downs to George Holani, fumbles, chest injury, and Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. Passes eye test long-term though. Projections updated for Price (chest).

items.implication: Near-term fantasy fade; longer-term stash if eye test holds.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down shares shift to Wilson/Holani/Charbonnet; monitor SEA RB committee.

items.implication: Full dual-threat QB1 confirmed; Ravens offense at full strength.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.why: Cleared on Texans Friday report.
items.implication: HOU WR1 returns; full target share expected.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% prior). On pace for 64 catches after 26 in 14 games last year. Only 4-game sample.
items.why: Sampson absence drives pass-game role expansion; data-backed pace.
items.implication: PPR RB2/flex with receiving upside beyond pure rush work.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes, and third-down usage in CLE backfield.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list: led RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches. Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse snaps/touches with teammate out; strong matchup.
items.implication: Must-start RB1/2 in PPR/standard.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap share, carries, and receiving work.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love on LOVE list: RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week (more than W1+W2 combined). Double-digit target share every game. NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.why: Exploding usage + soft run defense matchup.
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with upside.
items.opportunity: High touch/target volume sustained.

items.text: Drake London on LOVE: 35% career target share/104 YPG with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix healthy; favorable WR TD matchup.
items.implication: WR1 upside locked in.
items.opportunity: Dominant routes/targets/red-zone with starting QB.

items.text: Omarion Hampton on HATE list: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% W3 (13% third downs). SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage profile + tough run defense.
items.implication: Sit/avoid in most formats; low floor.
items.opportunity: Limited snaps/routes/targets/carries; no expansion signal.
